d: When Mr. Ochmonek becomes sick during flight, ALF flies the plane.
ALF is relocated to the family garage as a result of his mischievous behavior.
ALF visits "Gilligan's Island" castaways Gilligan, the Skipper, the Professor and Mary Ann.
Mrs. Ochmonek thinks she's seeing things when she spots ALF in the backyard.
A secret compels ALF to join a monastery.
The Tanners become a TV ratings family, and ALF decides to rig the system.
ALF becomes the star attraction at the Tanners' Halloween party.
ALF helps Lynn boost her self-confidence by enrolling her in a beauty pageant.
ALF gets a severe case of hiccups after being excluded from Dorothy and Whizzer's wedding party.
Willie and ALF hop on board a freight train in search of adventure.
ALF and the Tanner kids give Willie and Kate a second honeymoon.
Kate dreams she and ALF are opponents in a presidential election.
ALF is trapped in a box of toys going to a children's hospital.
ALF befriends the Ochmoneks' belligerent nephew (Josh Blake). With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
ALF demands a fair trial after being accused of throwing a ball through the Ochmoneks' window.
ALF believes that he scared Willie's (Max Wright) uncle to death. With Ann Schedeen.
ALF catches a burglar in the Ochmonek home.
A SWAT team traps ALF in the Ochmonek home.
ALF's overprotectiveness exasperates a blind friend.
ALF becomes jealous of the attention paid to a stray dog.
Brian's brush with a bully drives Willie to violence.
ALF's antics scare potential buyers of the Tanner house.
ALF's mail-order ventriloquist's dummy takes on a life of its own.
Kate's friend, a known drinker, sees ALF in the kitchen and thinks she's hallucinating.
Frustrated ALF imagines revealing his existence to the world.
ALF's living expenses sap Lynn's college fund.
ALF hides out in the back seat during Lynn's date at the drive-in.
A guardian angel shows ALF what life would be without him.
The Tanners let Trevor Ochmonek stay at their house after he has a fight with his wife.
ALF is guest host on "The Tonight Show."
Betrayed confidences cause a falling-out between ALF and Lynn.
The Tanners are invited to a Thanksgiving dinner with the Ochmoneks' bizarre relatives.
ALF must avoid the Alien Task Force when a bum blows the whistle on him.
Kate (Anne Schedeen) goes back to work when a strike sends Willie (Max Wright) home.
In a nightmare, Willie (Max Wright) dreams ALF is his school roommate. With Anne Schedeen.
A tabloid story may contain a clue to ALF's long-lost cousin's whereabouts.
ALF makes Brian (Benji Gregory) disappear with a mail-order magic kit. With Max Wright.
ALF is convinced gangsters are chasing the Tanners' houseguest.
ALF's expose earns Willie a guest spot on David Horowitz's consumer advocate show.
ALF is convinced that a reclusive neighbor is actually Elvis Presley.
ALF has a reaction and realizes he is allergic to a baby (Nancy Lenehan, Stephanie Hagen).
An extortionist threatens to turn ALF in as an illegal alien.
ALF ghostwrites Jake's (Josh Blake) love letters. With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
ALF accidentally invokes a Melmacian superstition.
Lynn winds up with two dates when ALF bungles a phone message.
Desperate for a pet of his own, ALF acquires an ant farm. With Max Wright and Benji Gregory.
ALF and Jake suggest Brian camp out to overcome his fear of the dark.
ALF sees Jake's (Josh Blake) mother steal Kate's (Anne Schedeen) brooch. With Max Wright.
ALF imagines in black and white that he and the Tanners are silent-movie stars.
ALF prepares for the worst after experiencing a mild earthquake.
ALF prepares for the baby's arrival by re-enacting scenes from "The Dick Van Dyke Show".
ALF earns the right to baby-sit Eric, but almost blows it when the child disappears.
ALF is accidentally photographed by tabloid photographers. With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
A TV show issues an alert for a criminal who resembles Willie.
ALF discovers and later becomes addicted to the art of making stock-market deals.
After a visit from a psychologist, ALF subjects the Tanners to a barrage of unwanted psychoanalysis.
Willie holds a support group meeting to help ALF with his cotton addiction.
ALF, forced to hide, plots the removal of Willie's visiting brother.
ALF gets peeved about having to remain hidden while Willie's brother extends his visit.
ALF's attitude toward cats changes after his first encounter with kittens.
ALF's attitude toward cats changes after his first encounter with kittens.
Whizzer comes face-to-face with ALF when he searches for Dorothy at the Tanners.
ALF, on the outs with the Tanners, is offered a place to stay by Neal.
ALF is pampered by the Tanners after catching his first Earth cold.
ALF is relegated once again to the attic when the Tanners throw a Hawaiian luau.
ALF dreams he's a comic; guests Casey Kasem, Brandon Tartikoff.
Neal's wife wants to reconcile, but ALF suspects her motives.
ALF enters the art world after he earns praise for a still life made from food.
As a newly ordained Melmacian minister, ALF must officiate a ceremony on Earth.
ALF considers the future with the Tanners, who will age faster than the ageless alien.
ALF sneaks into a retirement home to meet a former film idol.
ALF prods Willie to take him on a Death Valley treasure hunt.
A morally outraged ALF writes nasty letters to a pollution-producing company.
ALF takes to the park in search of food after his diet fails.
Lynn wants to live with her boyfriend; ALF wants Lynn's room.
ALF makes plans to join other Melmac survivors.
ALF adopts the Tanners after crash-landing into their garage.
ALF decides to have some fun while a nervous Mrs. Ochmonek baby-sits Brian.
When Lucky the cat disappears, everyone blames ALF. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF calls the president to address his concerns about nuclear weapons.
ALF takes a job selling cosmetics over the phone. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF makes his first friend outside the Tanner family, Jody, a lonely blind girl.
Willie (Max Wright) helps homesick ALF arrange a trip to Melmac.
Lynn is excited because Scott wants to keep all his band equipment in the Tanners' garage.
On his 45th birthday, Willie feels unfulfilled, so ALF suggests he go skydiving.
ALF sells parts of his spaceship to buy Lynn (Andrea Elson) a Ferrari.
Willie loses his temper with ALF during a family camping trip.
ALF convinces Willie to travel to the mountains to cut down a real Christmas tree.
ALF heads for the garage when Kate's mother (Anne Meara) pays a visit. Kate: Anne Schedeen.
ALF submits scripts to his favorite soap opera. Guest stars Anne Meara as Kate's mother.
ALF tries to set Dorothy up with her new neighbor, Whizzer Deaver.
When ALF has amnesia, the Tanners try to help by reviewing past events.
ALF befriends a young Mexican immigrant. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF goes through a 24-hour period of bizarre behavior. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
Willie (Max Wright) talks to a psychologist (Bill Daily) about ALF.
ALF thinks he witnessed a murder at a neighbor's house. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF comes to Brian's aid when the boy has to play an asparagus in the school play.
ALF's newly developed gambling habit gets him deeply in debt.
Brian causes trouble at school when he repeats some of ALF's intergalactic knowledge.
